name: SafeSnap – WordPress Backup & Security
author: PluginJoy

sections.description:
SafeSnap gives you peace of mind with automatic daily backups (database + full files), one-click manual backups, and safe one-click restore — all stored locally and protected from public access.

Perfect for bloggers, shops, and agencies who want a lightweight, reliable backup solution without bloat.

Features (free):
– Daily full backup (DB + files)
– One-click manual backup
– One-click restore (latest or specific)
– Real-time core file monitoring
– 7-day retention
– No external services or tracking

Pro version adds cloud storage, SMS alerts, and more.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/safesnap
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to SafeSnap menu — backups start automatically
sections.faq:
Where are backups stored?

In /wp-content/uploads/safesnap/backups/ (protected from direct access)

Can I restore with one click?

Yes! Choose any backup from the Restore tab.
sections.changelog:

  • Protected backup folder from direct access
  • Fixed zip self-inclusion bug
  • Improved DB export (handles binary data)
  • Tested with WordPress 6.8

  • Initial release
